findings.title: Cookie consent banner obscures the mobile first viewport
evidence: A 390x844 browser screenshot of https://facodi.com/pt/ shows the fixed consent banner covering the lower part of the learning-map hero.
The banner occupies the bottom of the viewport before consent is selected and pushes the primary content out of view.
findings.impact: Mobile visitors cannot see or interact with the full first-viewport learning map and may miss content or controls behind the banner.
findings.recommendation: Use a compact mobile consent layout with a bounded max-height, safe-area spacing, and a close/decision flow that does not obscure the primary hero content; test at 320, 390 and 430 CSS pixels.
findings.verification: Repeat screenshots and keyboard/focus checks at mobile widths with the banner visible and after each consent choice.

findings.title: Public homepage and catalogue pages lack meta descriptions
evidence: Rendered DOM inspection of https://facodi.com/pt/ found no meta[name=description].
Rendered DOM inspection of https://facodi.com/pt/slides found no meta[name=description].
The same pages expose og:title but no og:description.
findings.impact: Search and social previews have no authored summary and may use poor snippets or omit useful context.
findings.recommendation: Add localized Website/page descriptions for the homepage and catalogue, and ensure Odoo emits matching og:description values where supported.
findings.verification: Inspect rendered head tags for EN, PT, FR and ES and validate the sitemap URLs after deployment.

findings.title: Localized homepage canonical points to the internal FACODI page route
evidence: The visible homepage route is https://facodi.com/pt and the Website page record for the homepage uses the root route.
The English homepage similarly renders canonical https://facodi.com/facodi.
findings.impact: Search engines may index the internal page route as the preferred URL and split signals between the homepage route and its canonical target.
findings.recommendation: Make the canonical URL for each localized homepage equal to the public localized homepage route, or intentionally redirect and document the route policy. Check all language variants before changing data.
findings.verification: Check canonical, hreflang and redirect behavior for /, /pt/, /fr/ and /es/ after deployment.

findings.title: Website Translation profile has no usable AI connection
evidence: Live facodi.ai.profile record website_translation is active but has no provider_id and no connection_id.
facodi_ai.default_provider is gemini and both provider records are active, but facodi.ai.service._run requires a resolved active connection and raises configuration error when none exists.
The public translation controller correctly rejects unauthenticated calls with an Odoo Session Expired response.
findings.impact: Authorized Website editors cannot complete AI-assisted translation until an active connection is configured, even though the feature and fallback provider setting appear enabled.
findings.recommendation: Configure a provider connection through the administrator UI using the intended environment-backed credential, then run a controlled authenticated translation test. Do not store or include the credential in this report.
findings.production_action: administrator configuration, subject to credential rotation
findings.verification: Confirm the profile resolves to an active connection, execute one disposable translation as an authorized Website editor, and verify no key appears in request records or logs.

findings.title: Two courses contain duplicate slide titles within the same course
evidence: Course 9 contains slide IDs 352 and 353 with the same title: Automatic Coolify Backups to Hetzner Object Storage - 2025.
Course 12 contains slide IDs 446 and 447 with the same title: Certifications | Odoo Human Resources.
findings.impact: Learners and editors cannot distinguish the duplicate lessons reliably from course navigation, search results or progress records.
findings.recommendation: Confirm whether each pair is intentionally duplicated; otherwise rename or remove one record through the normal Website/eLearning workflow and preserve source provenance.
findings.verification: Re-run the within-course duplicate-title check and open both resulting lesson URLs.
